title: Process Cannot Bind to Port (EADDRINUSE)
symptom: Starting application fails with error: 'bind: Address already in use' or port collision.
initial_observations: Previous instance of daemon was killed or crashed.

possible_causes.cause: Orphaned or zombie daemon process still holding the listening socket
possible_causes.evidence_needed: ss -tlnp shows existing PID bound to target port.
possible_causes.remediation: Terminate rogue process via `kill -15 <PID>` (or `kill -9 <PID>` if unresponsive).

possible_causes.cause: Socket currently lingering in TIME_WAIT state
possible_causes.remediation: Enable SO_REUSEADDR in application server configuration.

investigation_steps.title: Identify Process Holding the Port
investigation_steps.explanation: List PID and program name currently bound to the port.

verification: Application starts and successfully opens listening socket.
prevention: Configure graceful process shutdown and SO_REUSEADDR socket option.
